name: HarnessMM
description: Guarded decision reuse over the native tool surface: the model authors one CHISEL action bank, each candidate carries a receipt-local guard, and a certified native substitution replaces the slow reasoning callback when that guard already holds.
config.policy.enabled: Enable guarded decision reuse. On, the plan section is injected and the model is asked to author action banks; off, the stock loop runs unchanged.
config.policy.maximum_candidates: Maximum candidates in one authored action bank (1-16).
config.policy.maximum_fast_steps: Maximum substituted steps before the graph is exhausted and the slow actor must run again (1-16).
config.policy.maximum_public_bytes: Maximum size of the public selector state in bytes (1024-65536).
config.policy.admission_threshold_tokens: Net tokens a step must save before a selector-assisted substitution is admitted (0-65536). The paper uses 1024; a profile whose selector shares the cached prefix can lower it. A single surviving candidate commits deterministically and is never gated by this.
config.selector.enabled: Ask a one-character selector which eligible candidate to run. Off means a multi-candidate step returns to the slow actor.
config.selector.provider: Provider for the selector. Empty reuses the boundary request's own route.
config.selector.model: Model for the selector. Empty reuses the boundary request's own model.
config.selector.maxTokens: Token budget for the selector call.
config.selector.timeoutMs: Timeout for the selector call in milliseconds.
config.shellTools: Shell tools the plan dialect may name. Empty detects bash/pwsh from the active tool catalog.
config.planSection: Inject the CHISEL plan section into the system prompt.
config.receiptsFile: Receipt JSONL path. Empty writes to $DSH_HOME/harnessmm/receipts.jsonl.
